newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to mull review of securities deal taxes -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to mull review of securities deal taxes -- MOF.

text.p: Japan will consider reviewing its securities transaction taxes and capital gains taxes as a part of overal reforms of its financial system, Nobuaki Usui, director of the Finance Ministry's Tax Bureau, told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday.
He said he wondered if it was a good idea to review securities transactions and capital gains taxes as a way to deal with daily movements in Tokyo stock prices.
"However, it is important to consider reviewing those taxes, as financial reforms and liberalisation of foreign exchange transactions are now on the agenda for discussion," Usui said.
Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto told the committee that a review of the taxes would be made as soon as possible before a planned reform of the financial system in 2001.
